title: Our 2026 Holiday Gift Guide
summary: Discover unique picture frame gift ideas for the holidays. Customize framed photos, collages, and more with Level Frames for the perfect present.
body_markdown:
## Why Framed Pictures Make the Perfect Holiday Gift


Framing a special photo or piece of art can create something incredibly unique and personal. That's why we're pleased to present our latest **Holiday** **Gift Guide,** featuring a number of ideas to help you get through holiday shopping with less stress.


We handcraft each frame here in the U.S. and are stocked with everything we need this season, but do encourage you to shop early as we get closer to Christmas. Given the made to order nature custom framing, our order cutoff for delivery by the 25th may be in the first week of December.


Let's get into how to find the right gift for anyone on your list with online framing!


## Popular Picture Frame Gift Options for 2026


### Framed Photos


Celebrate favorite people and moments with a[beautifully printed, custom framed photo](https://www.levelframes.com/photos) . It's one of the most personal gifts you can give.


We're making it easy to create one using pics of your family, travels, pet or any special occasion. Simply upload your image, select a print size and customize the frame.


> *Printed & Custom[Framed Photos](https://www.levelframes.com/guide/fetch_digital_selection) starting at $59*


We use museum-quality, archival materials to ensure that your gift looks amazing *and* stands the test of time.


### Collage Picture Frames


If you want to get really creative or can't decide which photo to go with, create a[collage picture frame](https://www.levelframes.com/collages/styles) . We'll guide you through the process and help you tell a story using up to thirty images per frame.


> *Customizable[Collage Picture Frames](https://www.levelframes.com/collage-picture-frames) starting at $80*


Choose from our selection of layouts, or use our customization tool to create a totally new layout. You can even customize the mat color, paper type and type of acrylic glaze.


### Tabletop Picture Frames


Our[tabletop picture frames](https://www.levelframes.com/tabletop-picture-frames) measure 9" x 11" and are designed to hang on the wall or stand comfortably on desks, tables and shelves. Take care of family gifting in one shot with our special pricing on these frames - **save $10 on a second tabletop** and every additional tabletop frame in the same order.


###


> *9" x 11"[Table Top Frames](https://www.levelframes.com/tabletop-picture-frames) - $49 for the first one, $39 each after that*


### The Simply Gifted Framed Photo


If you are pressed for time, or want to go with something tried and true, our[Simply Gifted framed photo](https://www.levelframes.com/frames/styles/simply-gifted) is handcrafted with the same care as everything else we make, but designed to meet deadlines and last minute gifting needs.


We print and mat your photo inside a 11.5" x 14" frame, and ship within a few business days.


> *Perfectly sized for gifting at 11.5" x 14",[The Simply Gifted Framed Photo](https://www.levelframes.com/frames/styles/simply-gifted)*


### Our Most Popular Styles


In addition to the Simply Gifted, we are curating a range of[popular frame styles](https://www.levelframes.com/frames/styles) that hit the mark on making photos (and walls) look amazing. Select one of these styles, upload your image and choose the frame color you like best. Or, stack them together and[put together a gallery wall](https://www.levelframes.com/gallery-walls) of framed photos.


> Six["The Classic" framed photos](https://www.levelframes.com/frames/styles/the-classic) at 15.5" x 19" in our Weathered Natural Profile


You can also find some of our most popular collage frame designs here, across a range of different sizes and layouts. We are continuously adding styles to help you tell stories with your favorite moments and memories in new ways.


---


## Unique and Fun Gift Ideas


If you want to to go a little of the beaten path, we have a number of ways to gift fun and getting things done!


### Framed Vinyl Records


###


We've devised a unique way of framing *actual records* such that the album cover shows in full, with the vinyl peeking out of its sleeve.


The result is a stunning presentation sure to connect with any music fan, especially if it involves their favorite album or artist.


> *"The Suburbs" from Arcade Fire and["Dark Side of the Moon" by Pink Floyd Framed Vinyl Record](https://www.levelframes.com/vinyl/dark-side-of-the-moon)*


We can source the records for you or you can send one in - if you don't see what you are looking for, just let us know so that we can hunt it down. Our completed[framed albums](https://www.levelframes.com/vinyl) start at $180 and ship ready to hang.


And if you already have a record that you want to frame and gift, we have a DIY framed album that[comes with everything you need to put it together at home](https://www.levelframes.com/vinyl/frame-at-home) .


### Personalized Framed Art


Use our new[AI Photo Editor](https://www.levelframes.com/ai-photo-editor) to create a magical pet portrait, dreamy watercolor of an unforgettable occasion, masterful sketch of a favorite place, or anything else that will surprise and delight your lucky recipient.


Once you find the perfect style for your photo, we'll print, frame and deliver your one-of-a-kind gift in just days.


### Framed Art Prints


We carry artwork from a number of featured artists that could be the perfect fit for someone on your list. Their joy in receiving it will be doubled by the fact that you've already taken care of the framing!


We've highlighted a number of talented artists in[our Five to Frame series](https://www.levelframes.com/five-to-frame) to uncover hidden gems and fresh perspectives in art.


> Framed art prints from[Invisible Creature](https://www.levelframes.com/artists/invisible-creature)


In addition to these artist spotlights, we have a growing collection of art prints available on[our Framed Artwork page](https://www.levelframes.com/framed-artwork) .


> *Custom framed art prints by[Ashley Percival](https://www.levelframes.com/collections/five-to-frame-ashley-percival/gallery) ,[Sebastian Curi](https://www.levelframes.com/collections/five-to-frame-sebastian-curi/gallery) ,[Brave the Woods](https://www.levelframes.com/collections/five-to-frame-brave-the-woods/gallery) and[Overview](https://www.levelframes.com/collections/five-to-frame-overview/gallery)*


##


## Perfect Gift for Travel Lovers


### Custom Framed Travel Tracker map


For anyone on your list who loves to travel, our[Travel Tracker map](https://www.levelframes.com/frames/prints/travel-tracker-map) makes it fun and easy to reminisce over past excursions and plot out future destinations.


Designed by our friend Brad Woodard of **Brave the Woods** , this Mid-Century Modern style map of the United States is printed on a sturdy canvas.


Each map arrives with a set of pushpins for marking the places you've been and those on your bucket list. Choose between two sizes, and customize with the frame of your choice.


---


## Easy Gifting Options


### Gift Cards


Give the gift of artwork or online custom framing with our gift card options, and let the lucky recipient decide what they like best. You can choose a digital card that delivers via email or a physical gift card that arrives by mail.


With our e-Gift Cards, simply select the amount and we’ll send your giftee a delightful email **on the date of your choosing** with all of the details. Perfect for last minute gifting.


[Send an e-Gift Card](https://www.levelframes.com/gift_cards/new) .


If you'd prefer to gift in person or want something you can place under the tree, choose an amount for[a physical gift card](https://www.levelframes.com/directory/gift-cards) and receive it by mail within 3 to 7 days.


Gift cards can be used on all custom framing services and framed artwork. Let us know if you are interested in a custom amount, or a bulk order discount (on 10 cards or more).


### Gift Note Options


We take great care in shipping each frame so that it arrives safely to its destination.


At no extra charge, we'll enclose a personalized note with the message of your choosing.


It's good for any framed photo, artwork or album, just look for the **Gifting option** at checkout.


---


## Important Shipping Deadlines for the 2026 Holiday Season


During the holiday season, we will keep the site updated with current lead times and the final dates we can accept orders for expected Christmas arrival. We expect it to be sometime in the second week of December this year.


Normally, turnaround time on framed photos is 3 to 5 days from the date of your order. Transit time adds another 1 to 5 business days, so expect everything to arrive within a week or less.


Vinyl records and certain framed artist prints take an additional 5 to 10 days depending on where we are sourcing the album or artwork. Please check the specific delivery and Christmas cutoff dates before ordering for vinyl records, framed artwork and any of our custom framed memo boards.


At checkout, there is a **Special Instructions** field which you can use to advise us of any specific deadlines. We will do our best to hit them, and let you know if we're unable to do so for a given order. Expedited shipping is an option on some orders by request.


You can also check with us before ordering via the live chat on the site, or by sending an email to **hello@levelframes.com** .


---


Did you know that the Level Rewards program lets you earn credits on every order?


[Sign up now](https://www.levelframes.com/join) or during checkout for **$15 in credits** that can be used towards your first order. We'll drop another $25 in credits into your account for every $500 you spend.


---


## Thanks and Happy Gifting!


- The Team at Level Frames
